# Synthetic document fixtures (T13)

Every file here is synthetic. The CNPJs are the repository's long-standing test
numbers (`11222333000181`, `11444777000161`), the RFB published example of the
alphanumeric CNPJ (`12ABC34501DE35`, docs/fiscal/cnpj-alfanumerico.md) and one
alphanumeric number derived from it for tests (`98ZYX76501AB50`); none is a real
company's. The PDFs are hand-built single-page files with Helvetica text; the XML
follows the public NF-e 4.00 and national NFS-e 1.00 element names only as far as
the extractors read them.
